sources: recreation.gov public campsite search API for 233739 (per-site catalog), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $26 a night in the peak season (2026: May 15 - September 26; 2027: May 21 - September 25), covering 2 vehicles or an RV/trailer with tow vehicle; $9 a night per extra vehicle (interagency passes do not apply to it). Off season (limited service from October 1) there is no fee and no amenities.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/swan-creek-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night. Off Season, there is no fee and no amenities available. Peak Season, there is a $26.00 fee which includes 2 driving vehicles. $9.00 each additional vehicle.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233739/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season 'PeakSTANDARD NONELECTRIC': 26), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Full service May 16 - September 30, weather dependent; limited service (no fee, no amenities) October 1 - December 31. Swan Creek Road is closed at US-191 to wheeled vehicles December 2 - May 15 (the campground stays open to snowmobile or foot access), so December 1 is the last drive-in night.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/swan-creek-campground (Seasons of Use: '5/16 - 9/30 Weather Dependent', 'Limited Service 10/1 - 12/31'; Current Conditions: 'Swan Creek Road is closed at Highway 191 from December 2nd - May 15th to all wheeled motorized vehicles. Campsite remains open to users who wish to access Swan Creek Campground by other means'; Directions: 'Road opens 5/16 - 12/1'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 233739 (all 13 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 13 single-family sites; paved roads, gravel parking spurs averaging 16 x 45 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/swan-creek-campground ('Camp sites: 13'; 'Trailer/RV Sites Average Parking Spur:16' x 45''; 'Roads within the campground are paved, but parking spurs are gravel'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Hand-pump drinking water, trash collection and food storage lockers; firewood $10 a bundle at Greek Creek Campground.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/swan-creek-campground ('Vault toilets, drinking water and trash collection are provided', 'No RV Dump Station', 'There are NO Shower facilities available at this campground') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233739 (amenities 'Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Food Storage Locker'; notice 'No RV Dump Station is located in any of the USFS campgrounds managed by ExplorUS in the Custer-Gallatin National Forest'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Concession-run on the Custer Gallatin NF (recreation.gov names ExplorUS; the Forest Service page names Rocky Mountain Recreation Company). All 13 sites are reservable on recreation.gov until 3 days before arrival; 'Sites may be available on a first-come, first-served basis during and outside the reservation season; call (406) 646-1012.' Reserved sites are held until check-out time the day after the scheduled arrival. 16-night limit.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233739 (rules: reservationCutOff 3, maxConsecutiveStay 16; notice 'Reserved campsites will be held until check-out time on the day following your scheduled arrival'; facility email @goexplorus.com) + recreation.gov catalog (13 of 13 reservable) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/swan-creek-campground ('Sites may be available on a first-come, first-served basis during and outside the reservation season'; 'Contact Name: Rocky Mountain Recreation Company'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF campground in Gallatin Canyon, 30 mi S of Bozeman then 1 mi E on Swan Creek Rd, beside Swan Creek (a Gallatin River tributary) under dense spruce and fir at 5,800 ft; Upper/Lower loops; the Swan Creek Trail starts in the campground. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page + recreation.gov: confirmed $26 (2026), 13 sites, no electric/water hookups, vault toilets, hand-pump water, no showers, reservable on recreation.gov (derived values now verified). Added the free limited-service off season (fees 26/26 -> 0/26), season May 16 - Dec 1 (full service to Sept 30, road closed Dec 2 - May 15), no dump station, fcfs after_cutoff with the 3-day cutoff, 16-night limit. Concession-run (ExplorUS per recreation.gov / Rocky Mountain Recreation Company per FS). Not stated: max rig length (average spur 45 ft; the derived 50 left alone). No FS alert for this campground or road.
flags: Missing phone: recreation.gov's facility phone and the FS page give (406) 646-1012 for the campground; the concessionaire's line is (661) 702-1420 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/swan-creek-campground).
Operator names disagree: recreation.gov's contact email and notices name ExplorUS, the Forest Service page names Rocky Mountain Recreation Company.
max_rig_ft 50 (derived from the note) is not stated on either page; the FS gives only an average parking spur of 16 x 45 ft and the catalog lists no lengths.
